map.：推力 F=1000 N、质量流率 ṁ=0.4 kg/s。Isp=1000/(0: : With thrust F=1000 N and mass flow ṁ=0.4 kg/s, Isp=1000/(0.4×9.81)=1000/3.924≈255 s. A typical liquid hydrogen/oxygen engine reaches 440+ s in vacuum; the higher it is, the more impulse per unit of propellant.
map.比冲单位为什么是秒？: Why Is the Unit of Specific Impulse Seconds?
map.Isp=F/(ṁg₀)，量纲为秒，表示'每单位重量流量的冲量'。秒数越大发动机越: Isp=F/(ṁg₀), with units of seconds, meaning the impulse per unit weight flow rate. The larger the number in seconds, the more propellant-efficient the engine. It can also be read directly as exhaust velocity v_e=Isp·g₀ (m/s).
map.比冲高一定好吗？: Is Higher Specific Impulse Always Better?
map.对 Δv 效率越高越好，但常伴随低推力（电推）或复杂/昂贵系统（高室压、低温推进: For a given Δv higher efficiency is better, but it often comes with low thrust (electric propulsion) or complex and expensive systems (high chamber pressure, low-temperature propellants). Trade off efficiency, thrust, and cost for the mission.
